proposedSkills.name: Verified Adaptive Explanation
proposedSkills.description: Explains technical material at the depth a specific reader needs by modelling that reader's prior knowledge and reading mode, then verifying every cited output, diagram and quotation against the source artifact before delivery.

evidence.notes: MIT-licensed skill with a documented persona-to-question-to-artifact workflow, runnable output checks, diagram fact sheets, HTML verification scripts, examples and regression tests. Technical procedure is inspectable; no independent effectiveness result is asserted.

Third-party skills.sh listing observed 2026-11-03: 393 installs for the explainer skill and about 1.6K installs across the repository's listed skills. Marketplace counters are not unique active users.
Separate public marketplace indexes the creator's explainer skills; discovery evidence only, not independent efficacy validation.
